claims.label: Erika Kirk directed "Stop" to Candace Owens in CBS town hall
claims.claim: During a Bari Weiss CBS town hall, when asked what she wanted to say to Candace Owens and others "putting these lies out into the world," Erika Kirk responded: "Stop. That's it. That's all I have to say. Stop."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the verbatim exchange against the published CBS video and check whether the question appears in any released pre-production packet.

claims.label: Erika Kirk stated "the truth is very clear" about the assassination in Glenn Beck interview
claims.claim: In a Blaze TV interview clip the host plays, Erika Kirk affirmed Glenn Beck's framing that "the truth is very clear" regarding her husband's assassination.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the unedited Blaze TV segment to verify exact phrasing and surrounding context.

claims.label: Erika Kirk denied TPUSA and personal involvement in Kirk's murder
claims.claim: In the Glenn Beck interview, Erika Kirk stated: "None of us are involved in my husband's murder. None of us. Turning Point USA, myself, any of these other crazy accusations, none of us."
claims.investigative_direction: Compare this on-camera denial against any subsequent documentary disclosures or investigation findings that could contradict the explicit denial.

claims.label: Glenn Beck Tells Erika Kirk Some Online Content Is Mental Illness
claims.claim: In the Glenn Beck interview clip the host plays, Glenn Beck appears to tell Erika Kirk: "I don't need you to comment on this, but I think mental illness is involved in some of this stuff that is online. I think it's really honestly I feel bad it's mental illness."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the exact context of the "mental illness" statement against the unedited interview and assess whether the framing was directed at named hosts or general public commentary.

claims.label: Erika Kirk stated husband's "legacy is not about his murder"
claims.claim: In the Glenn Beck interview, Erika Kirk stated: "My husband's legacy is not about his murder. My husband's legacy is what he left behind."
claims.investigative_direction: Document the recurrence of this framing across Erika Kirk's post-assassination appearances to map the consistency and evolution of the messaging.

claims.label: Erika Kirk called for public education about the court system to preserve an untainted jury pool
claims.claim: In the Glenn Beck interview, Erika Kirk stated: "A lot of people don't and I think that we need to do a better job of educating our citizens about our court systems. … I don't want a tainted jury pool. I want justice for my husband."
claims.investigative_direction: Track whether this "education" framing recurs in subsequent Erika Kirk appearances and whether any coordinated media campaigns explicitly call on influencers to refrain from commentary.

claims.label: Host Says Tyler Robinson Made His First In-Person Court Appearance
claims.claim: The host says Tyler Robinson finally appeared in person, making his first in-person court appearance.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the official docket entry and any released court transcript for the December 11, 2025 hearing; verify demeanor observation against available footage.

claims.label: Allie Beth Stuckey accused Candace Owens of using BLM "Kafka trap" tactics
claims.claim: In an Instagram post, Allie Beth Stuckey asserted that "Candace has taken a page out of their [BLM's] book," characterizing the host's insistence that critics are part of a psyop or are paid as a 2020-style Kafka trap.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the post is still publicly available and capture a screenshot for permanent record; compare Stuckey's characterization against any prior host statements.

claims.label: Allie Beth Stuckey publicly defended Alex Clark, Lila Rose, Ben Shapiro, Josh Hammer, and Seth
claims.claim: In a show clip the host plays, Allie Beth Stuckey defended Alex Clark, Lila Rose, Ben Shapiro, Josh Hammer, and Seth against Candace Owens' accusations, stating she knows them personally and that they do not deserve to be "implicated in this way"; the host then mockingly adds that they do not deserve "to be called out when they're lying."
claims.investigative_direction: Catalog each prior host accusation against these five individuals and verify against any underlying evidence the host has produced; assess consistency of Stuckey's defense with the underlying evidence.

claims.label: Allie Beth Stuckey indicated her content is "not for you" if you question her biblical authority framing
claims.claim: In an Instagram comment reply, Allie Beth Stuckey wrote: "You don't see value in learning how to decipher truth logically and biblically, and that's okay. My content is not for you then."
claims.investigative_direction: Capture the comment thread for permanent record and identify the original commenter if investigatively relevant.

claims.label: Bari Weiss CBS town hall was pre-recorded with pre-selected questions (per host insider sources)
claims.claim: The host asserts that the Bari Weiss / Erika Kirk CBS town hall was pre-recorded from about 11:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., citing sources at CBS News; that audience members were emailing her; that there were multiple takes because Bari Weiss wanted to read a prompter; and that the questions were pre-submitted.
claims.investigative_direction: Attempt to obtain leaked production documents, backstage emails, or testimony from audience members; cross-reference against CBS's own statements about the production.

claims.label: Maroon color is associated with the U.S. Air Force and the Army 10th Mountain Brigade (per host military sources)
claims.claim: The host asserts that the maroon color referenced in connection with Kirk event attendees (and noted by the host in prior episodes) represents the U.S. Air Force and the Army 10th Mountain Brigade, citing military contacts.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify through official U.S. military color standards (Air Force: ultramarine blue, not maroon; 10th Mountain Brigade: maroon beret was a separate uniform item historically) and reconcile against authoritative dress-regulation documents.

claims.label: Host lists statements she calls lies on the SD card removal, Charlie's DOGE and drones
claims.claim: The host lists statements she calls lies: that Terryl Farnsworth was told by police to remove the SD card (she says Farnsworth told her otherwise); that it was not unusual for Charlie Kirk to set up a DOGE; and that Charlie Kirk's team did not fly drones, a lie she attributes to Brian Harpole, along with his statement that security secured the rooftops with UVU police.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Farnsworth's account, the DOGE timeline and the drone and rooftop statements against police and UVU records.
claims.transcript_snippet: Lie. Charlie established a doge and it was not unusual. That's a lie. It was unusual.

claims.label: Host Says the Erika Kirk Interviews Are the Final Stop of a TPUSA PR Campaign
claims.claim: The host says she guesses, and hopes, that the Bari Weiss and Glenn Beck interviews are the final stop of a PR campaign that brings Erika Kirk out so the public feels it cannot question the judgment of a widow.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify who organized the Erika Kirk media rollout (CBS, Blaze TV) and any PR firm engaged by Turning Point USA.
claims.transcript_snippet: I guess this is kind of the final stop. I'm hoping it's the final stop of this PR campaign where they are now pivoting and bringing Erika out

claims.label: Host Lists Three Talking Points She Says the Campaign Uses
claims.claim: The host says the talking points she sees are that there is a bigger mission, that questioning will ruin the trial, and that doubters are mentally ill.
claims.investigative_direction: Compile the three framings as they appear across Erika Kirk, Turning Point USA and influencer statements with dates, to test whether the wording is coordinated.
claims.transcript_snippet: Another talking point. It's going to ruin the trial. If you guys keep thinking that things don't make sense, you could ruin the case.

claims.label: Host Says No Amount of Pressure Will Convince Her a Neck Stopped a .30-06 Bullet
claims.claim: The host says no amount of propaganda will convince the masses that a human neck stopped a .30-06 bullet.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the autopsy and ballistic findings on bullet caliber, path and whether the bullet was recovered.
claims.transcript_snippet: There's not a number that is going to convince the masses uh that his neck, human neck, stopped a.30-06 bullet, okay?

claims.label: Host Says the Front of Charlie Kirk's Neck Showed Minimal Damage
claims.claim: The host says there was minimal damage to the front of Charlie Kirk's neck, and she asks viewers to produce any documented case of a .30-06 being stopped by a human neck.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the autopsy and medical-examiner description of the entry wound and the surgeon accounts of the wound.
claims.transcript_snippet: But not only are they saying that they stopped it, but I want to remind you that there was minimal damage to to the front of Charlie's neck as well, okay?

claims.label: Host Describes the Official Account as the Bullet Ricocheting Downward Into His Stomach
claims.claim: The host describes the official account as the bullet going cleanly into Charlie Kirk's neck and then ricocheting downward into his stomach.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm from the autopsy report or official statements whether a downward ricochet into the abdomen is the stated trajectory.
claims.transcript_snippet: So, it didn't even cause a lot of, you know, damage as it went in. It just cleanly went in and then ricocheted downward into his stomach.

claims.label: Host Calls Bari Weiss a Tel Aviv Agent With Epstein-Style Promotion
claims.claim: The host says Bari Weiss is "just a Tel Aviv agent," citing her studies in Tel Aviv, her family ties and what the host calls a hand of Midas that pulled her through the ranks, and adds that she became chief at CBS News despite sub-average intelligence.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Bari Weiss's published biography and CBS News appointment record; the "agent" characterization is the host's opinion, recorded as said.
claims.transcript_snippet: And Bari is obviously just a Tel Aviv agent. Her entire background story, her rise, her studying in Tel Aviv, her family ties

claims.label: Host Says Weiss's Question Was Likely Reviewed by Lawyers and Delivered From a Script
claims.claim: The host says the question Bari Weiss asked Erika Kirk was likely reviewed and marked up by lawyers and that Weiss had it ahead of time.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain CBS legal-review or production records for the town hall question set; none is shown on air.
claims.transcript_snippet: this question, like I said, has likely, by the way, been reviewed and marked up by lawyers, but she still is not even convincing despite having it ahead of time

claims.label: Weiss's Question Says Candace Owens Is Making a Huge Amount of Money From Conspiracies
claims.claim: The clip played has Bari Weiss describing Candace Owens as a former friend of Charlie's and former Turning Point employee who is one of the main peddlers of conspiracies, making a huge amount of money and building her business off of these lies.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the question as aired with the unedited CBS broadcast and any Candace Owens revenue figures that are public.
claims.transcript_snippet: She has been one of the main peddlers of these conspiracies and she is making a huge amount of money on it. She is building her business off of these lies.

claims.label: Host Says She Already Had Her Business and Was at the Top of the Charts
claims.claim: The host says she already had her business and was already at the top of the charts, rebutting the claim that she built her business on the story.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare podcast chart rankings, book release dates and merch launch dates before and after September 10, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: Building her business, what are you talking about? I already had this business. I was already at top of the charts.

claims.label: Host Says Mikey McCoy Has Offered That His Father Was Confused
claims.claim: The host says Mikey McCoy offered that his dad was confused, that she accepts that and did not lie about it, and that Rob McCoy had said Mikey called his father first.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Rob McCoy's statements about whom Mikey McCoy called first with Mikey McCoy's statement that his father was confused, and with call logs if released.
claims.transcript_snippet: Mikey has offered that his dad was confused. I'll accept that. I didn't lie about that. Rob McCoy lied.

claims.label: Host Lists the Ate-Healthy Strong-Bones Neck Explanation as a TPUSA Lie
claims.claim: The host lists as a lie the claim that Charlie Kirk's neck stopped a .30-06 bullet because he ate healthy and had strong bones, which she says was presented as a modern-day Christian miracle.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify who first offered the strong-bones explanation and whether the surgeon or medical examiner endorsed it.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie's neck stopping a.30-06 bullet because he ate healthy and had strong bones. It was a modern-day Christian miracle.

claims.label: Host Lists "Charlie Never Wavered in His Support for Israel" as a Nasty Lie
claims.claim: The host lists the statement that Charlie never wavered in his support for Israel as a nasty lie.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect Charlie Kirk's own public statements and private texts on Israel from 2024 and 2025 to compare with the statement.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie never wavered in his support for Israel was a nasty lie.

claims.label: Host Says Turning Point USA Lied About Charlie Only Liking Catholic Architecture
claims.claim: The host says Charlie was a committed evangelical who only liked Catholic architecture was a statement Turning Point USA made, that it was a lie, and that she was attacked for pointing it out.
claims.investigative_direction: Find the original Turning Point USA or Alex Clark statement on Charlie's interest in Catholic architecture and compare with Charlie's documented Catholic inquiries.
claims.transcript_snippet: Turning Point USA lied about that and I was attacked for telling you

claims.label: Host Says She Proved Ben Shapiro's No-Bad-Blood Claim Was Not True
claims.claim: The host says Ben Shapiro said he and Charlie never had any bad blood, that she proved this was not true, and that this also came from Alex Clark pulling a PR move.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the texts the host cited and Shapiro's original statement to compare dates and wording.
claims.transcript_snippet: Ben Shapiro said they never had any bad blood between them. I proved that that was not true.

claims.label: Host Describes TPUSA Pattern: Accuse of Lying, Then Attack Her for Showing the Text
claims.claim: The host says Turning Point USA first accuses her of lying, she then proves she was not lying, and the strategy becomes attacking her for revealing a personal text message to defend herself.
claims.investigative_direction: List each instance where a text was released after an accusation of lying and the response that followed.
claims.transcript_snippet: how dare you reveal a personal text message to defend yourself from being called a liar

claims.label: Host Says Farnsworth Told Her the Police Did Not Tell Him to Remove the SD Card
claims.claim: The host says Terryl Farnsworth personally told her it was not true that police told him to remove the SD card, and that the account that he removed it because people were stealing hats is not what he told her.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Terryl Farnsworth's own account on record and police statements on the SD card removal.
claims.transcript_snippet: Terryl Farnsworth personally told me that that was not true. Taro removed the SD cards because people were stealing hats.

claims.label: Host Says Theft Would Have Led to Taking the Cameras, Not Just the SD Card
claims.claim: The host argues that if theft was the concern, someone would have taken the cameras and not only the SD card, particularly the card from the camera behind Charlie Kirk's head rather than those in front of him.
claims.investigative_direction: Document which cameras had SD cards removed and which were left in place, with equipment logs.
claims.transcript_snippet: you would have taken the cameras and not just the SD card particularly from the camera behind his head

claims.label: Host Says DOGE Did Not Exist Before Elon Musk, So Charlie's DOGE Was Unusual
claims.claim: The host says Charlie establishing a DOGE was unusual, because DOGE did not exist prior to Elon Musk making it a thing about government accountability.
claims.investigative_direction: Establish when the Turning Point USA internal DOGE was created and who proposed the name.
claims.transcript_snippet: Doge didn't even exist. Prior to Elon Musk making that a thing about government accountability.

claims.label: Host Says the Rooftop Security Claim Actually Referred to the Walkway Behind
claims.claim: The host says Brian Harpole's statement that security communicated with UVU police to secure the rooftops was a lie, and that it was actually the walkway behind.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Harpole's statement with UVU police and security coordination records for rooftops and the rear walkway.
claims.transcript_snippet: That was a lie. It was actually the walkway behind.

claims.label: Host Says Official Text Messages Were Presented Without Timestamps
claims.claim: The host lists as a federal oddity that the lover text messages were mysteriously presented without any timestamps.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full charging-document exhibits to see whether message metadata exists.
claims.transcript_snippet: The lover text messages mysteriously presented without any timestamps.

claims.label: Host Says the Claim That Tyler Robinson Confessed and Turned Himself In Is Not What Happened
claims.claim: The host says officials claimed Tyler Robinson confessed and turned himself in and that his father said he was guilty, which she says is not what happened.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the probable cause statement and press briefings with the father's account of the call to authorities.
claims.transcript_snippet: They claimed that he confessed and turned himself in. That's not what happened.

claims.label: Host Says It Was Never Revealed That Robinson Was at the Dairy Queen After the Assassination
claims.claim: The host says officials never revealed that Tyler Robinson was at the Dairy Queen after the assassination, and that she showed viewers he was throwing clothes away in the cemetery, which she calls problematic to the timeline.
claims.investigative_direction: Authenticate the Dairy Queen photo, its timestamp and any official acknowledgement of the stop.
claims.transcript_snippet: Never revealed that Tyler Robinson was at the Dairy Queen following the assassination.

claims.label: Host Says Tyler Robinson Was Not Arrested in a Maroon Shirt
claims.claim: The host says officials said Tyler Robinson was arrested wearing a maroon shirt and that this was not true.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the booking photograph, arrest report and clothing inventory.
claims.transcript_snippet: They said Tyler Robinson was arrested wearing a maroon shirt. That actually was also not true.

claims.label: Host Says Suicidal Intent and Fear of Being Shot Cannot Both Explain the Surrender
claims.claim: The host says officials claimed Tyler Robinson was suicidal and also turned himself in because he was afraid of being shot by police, and asks how both can be true.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the father's and pastor's accounts of the call with the charging document language.
claims.transcript_snippet: They said Tyler Robinson was suicidal but also turned himself in because he was afraid of being shot by police.

claims.label: Host Says Footage of Tyler Robinson Turning Himself In Is Missing
claims.claim: The host says the footage of Tyler Robinson turning himself in is mysteriously missing.
claims.investigative_direction: File records requests for surrender-site footage and the sheriff's office retention policy.
claims.transcript_snippet: And the footage mysteriously missing of Tyler Robinson turning himself in.

claims.label: Host Lists the Egyptian Planes Tracking Charlie and Erika Kirk as an Unanswered Question
claims.claim: The host says an unanswered question is the Egyptian planes tracking Charlie and following Erika throughout years, and says Turning Point USA laughed at these points.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check flight-tracking data for the Egyptian-registered aircraft against Kirk and Turning Point USA event dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: which is the Egyptian planes. Tracking Charlie, following Ericka throughout years. They said they're laughing at these things.

claims.label: Host Asks Where She Has Lied Rather Than Made a Minor Error Such as a Time Zone
claims.claim: The host says she is asking where she has explicitly lied rather than made a minor mistake, such as getting a time zone wrong, which critics answer by saying she lied about when a plane left.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the specific time-zone correction her critics cited and which flight or event it concerned.
